rom_observations.mapping: Pinned splat.yaml main segment ROM 0x1000 maps guest 0x80000400; ROM offset = guest - 0x80000000 + 0xC00.
rom_observations.instructions: 0x8001DA0C LUI/0x8001DA10 LWC1 loads the single-precision factor; 0x8001DA20,0x8001DA2C,0x8001DA48 MUL.S multiply r,p,h; 0x8001DA44,0x8001DA58,0x8001DA80 TRUNC.W.S convert to signed words before the GAME mask/table lookup.
rom_observations.adaptation: Use the observed binary32 factor and multiplication explicitly, rather than guessing SDK PI macro precision or retaining a double evaluation that differs at angle quantization boundaries.
